description: An unknown tuple with a dynamic element and no common type doesn't convert to a set of any
notes: Not disputed like native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error: the README defines convert's result as the conversion, and the spec makes this conversion an error, also for an unknown tuple, because the tuple's types already rule it out (spec.md#unknown-values-and-the-dynamic-pseudo-type): the dynamic pseudo-type unifies with any other type by selecting it, and is the result only if all the types are dynamic, so the bool and the tuple still need a common type, which they don't have (spec.md#type-unification). Like native/types/convert-unknown-tuple-to-list-of-any-with-dynamic-element-fails, with a set.
reference_error: all set elements must have the same type
